reply: {"action":"conclude","root_cause":"This conclusion comes from the rejected-fix feedback and the anomaly text. I did not run any probes or read any files. The rebirth thresholds in RebirthConfig (5000 for the first rebirth, 10000 for the second) are intended, and a test asserts them. Rebirth working at 6K, and resetting Cash and shop ownership, is therefore the designed behaviour. The real imbalance is in the upgrade tree data. Every shop item costs 500 or less, while income is about $32-40/s, so cash piles up unspent to 1.5K in R1 and 6K in R2. Costs do not scale with income, and rebirth is reachable cheaply because nothing else is worth buying.
